text: Golden’s unit of work is not the whole request; uncertainty slices can travel through different stages while the final route remains exact.
rationale: This makes orchestration proportional to decision boundaries instead of request size.

text: Design does not have to precede implementation; a narrowly bounded implementation can serve as the design probe before source-checked refinement.
rationale: It turns speculative design prose into evidence without changing authorship or custody.

text: A strategy decision is not single-use; it remains valid across related repairs until acceptance evidence falsifies it.
rationale: This removes repeated strategic recomputation while preserving independent acceptance.

text: ADHD alternatives need not be prose proposals; they can be tiny executable probes scored by observed behavior.
rationale: The option space becomes evidence-producing rather than document-producing.

text: Advice is not the first artifact; a concrete uncertainty or failure can summon targeted advice after local evidence exists.
rationale: This makes advice answer a live question instead of ceremonially preceding one.

text: Acceptance need not be conceived after delivery; its independent oracle can be authored when the work contract is formed and evaluated after change.
rationale: Separating oracle creation from execution preserves independence while removing duplicated framing work.
